events.verdict: Walker (CHA) catches the pass with his right foot in the air and then plants it as his pivot. He then releases his dribble prior to moving his pivot foot.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) is in a legal guarding position when Hernangomez (CHA) jumps backwards into him and the contact is incidental.
LAR shows that Middleton (MIL) makes incidental contact with Hernangomez's (CHA) hand while it is part of the ball.
Hernangomez (CHA) establishes himself in a legal guarding position during Antetokoumpo's (MIL) drive to the basket and the contact is incidental.
Williams (CHA) grabs and holds Antetokoumpo (MIL) and affects his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Bledsoe (MIL) maintains a legal guarding position during Walker (CHA)'s jump shot attempt.
Williams (CHA) briefly places an arm around Middleton (MIL) following the screen and the contact does not affect his SQBR.
[Observable in enhanced video] Antetokounmpo (MIL) shuffles his feet before prior to his shot attempt near the rim.
Hernangomez (CHA) makes contact with Antetokounmpo's (MIL) arm and affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Ilyasova (MIL) makes marginal contact with Batum's (CHA) arm during the rebound.
Hernangomez (CHA) briefly grasps Ilyasova's (MIL) shorts but does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Brogdon (MIL) maintains a legal guarding position during Monk's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Brogdon (MIL) cleanly deflects the ball away from Walker (CHA).
Hernangomez (CHA) establishes position from a wide stance, but absorbs the contact and does not deliver it to Bledsoe (MIL) on the screen.
Bledsoe (MIL) cleanly dislodges the ball from Walker (CHA).
Walker (CHA) slides his pivot foot at the end of his dribble.

LAR shows that Ilyasova (MIL) jumps to contest the drive to the basket by Walker (CHA) and makes contact with the ball with his left leg. Bledsoe (MIL) reaches in and also makes contact with the ball.
Hernangomez (CHA) cleanly steals the pass deflected by Walker (CHA).
Kidd-Gilchrist (CHA) briefly places two hands on Antetokoumpo (MIL) during the inbound but does not affect his SQBR.
Lopez (MIL) briefly clamps Williams' (CHA) arm following the screen, but the contact does not affect his ability to defend the play.

LAR shows that Hernangomez (CHA) initiates the body contact with Antetokounmpo (MIL) and affects his driving shot attempt. The whistle occurs at approximately 00:25.5, but the clock is reset to 00:24.5.
Henson (MIL) maintains a legal guarding position on Walker's (CHA) driving shot attempt.

Hernangomez (CHA) and Middleton (MIL) engage during the rebound, but do not affect each other's ability to retrieve the rebound.
